summary: This class discusses whether to recite Yud Gimmel Middot before taking out the Sefer Torah on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. It examines the custom according to the Mekubalim and the tradition in Halab based on various Hachamim.
questions: Should Yud Gimmel Middot be recited before taking out the Sefer Torah?
What was the custom in Halab regarding Yud Gimmel Middot at Petihat HaEikhal?
How did the Mekubalim view reciting Yud Gimmel Middot on holidays?
What happened in the Halabi community in Brazil in 1961?
